description_en: Performs a paged query on the list of HiMarket chat sessions, returning the session ID, name, conversation type, and associated API products for each session. The response also includes the paging page number, paging size, and total count
description_zh: 分页查询 HiMarket 聊天会话列表，每个会话返回会话 ID、名称、对话类型以及关联的 API 产品，响应同时返回分页页码、分页大小与总数量
name: ListChatSessions

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. The default value and value range are not specified in the API definition
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数。默认值与取值范围未在接口定义中声明
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Pass the nextToken returned in the previous response to obtain the next page. Do not specify this parameter for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标。传入上一次响应返回的 nextToken 以获取下一页，首次查询不传
parameters.name: next_token

content.description_en: The list of chat sessions. Each element in the list is named session and represents a chat session
content.description_zh: 聊天会话列表，列表元素名为 session，每个元素为一个聊天会话

name.description_en: The name of the chat session

products.description_en: The list of API products associated with the session. Each element in the list is named product
products.description_zh: 该会话关联的 API 产品列表，列表元素名为 product

items.description_en: An API product associated with the session
items.description_zh: 参与该会话的 API 产品

sessionId.description_en: The ID of the chat session. You can use this ID to locate the session in API operations such as UpdateChatSession, DeleteChatSession, and ListConversations
sessionId.description_zh: 聊天会话 ID。可用于 UpdateChatSession、DeleteChatSession、ListConversations 等接口定位该会话

talkType.description_en: The conversation type of the session. Valid values: MODEL and AGENT. These values are defined in the talkType enumeration of the CreateChatSession request parameter, and this response parameter does not have the @enums annotation
talkType.description_zh: 会话的对话类型。取值：MODEL、AGENT（该取值集合声明在 CreateChatSession 入参 talkType 的枚举上，本出参未挂 @enums）

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries on the current page

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. An empty value indicates that the last page has been reached
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页游标。为空表示已到末页
